intro.text: The Fjordell Empire's ambassador to the court of Teod.

items.text: Fjorden had worked hard to win a place at the Teo court, yet Ashgress was called home all the same. He took his whole entourage with him and sailed from Teoras after giving one last speech at the docks.
His departure left King Eventeo uneasy about what Fjorden meant to do with Teod. Sarene feared it showed that the empire had stopped trying to win Teod over to Shu-Dereth altogether.
